name: Admin Accounting Income Bulk Settle
description: From the incomes multi-select, the bulk bar's [Acciones] menu offers "Registrar abono" (behind the bar's settleEnabled prop, incomes-only): one client payment distributed across the selected expected incomes with a SINGLE pocket movement. Eligible rows are company expected incomes with pending balance; a selection with none keeps the menu item disabled with the reason printed on the item itself (a disabled Headless UI MenuItem takes no focus and swallows the pointer, so a tooltip would be unreachable), and a partially eligible one opens the modal announcing how many were excluded. The modal (IncomeBulkSettleModal) lists the eligible incomes oldest-first (period_date, id tie-break) with Concepto/Fecha prevista/Pendiente/Imputado plus tfoot totals, a Valor recibido prefilled with the selection's total pending, the payment date defaulting to today's exact day with the month-only toggle, the destination stated below the amount/date row as the informational singleton 'Bolsillo ProjectApp' (no picker), and notes. The proposed distribution fills oldest-first (each pending fully, the one the money runs out on partial, zeros for the rest) and recomputes live while no row was touched; the first manual edit freezes it and offers 'Recalcular reparto'. Live summary: cubierto por completo / quedan $X sin cubrir / excedente $X - the excess is ACCEPTED as the client's saldo a favor (a parentless liquid child on the same movement, applied later by re-pointing its expected_income), which is why an excess over a mixed-client selection blocks with its own reason; rows above their own pending, a reparto summing above the valor and an all-zero reparto also block. Zero rows are allowed and dropped from the payload (skip that income). Confirming POSTs accounting/incomes/bulk-settle/ {total_amount, period_date, notes, allocations:[{income_id, amount}]}: the backend books ONE PocketMovement plus one liquid child per allocation sharing it (the child IS the per-income imputed amount, so payment_status keeps deriving untouched); fully covered incomes turn Pagado and the partial one stays Parcial with its faltan amount in the existing Cobro column. Success clears the selection, toasts 'Abono registrado' with the pagados/parciales count and refetches incomes while dropping the cached pocket ledger; a 409 records_not_found drops exactly the missing ids and reloads; a 400 keeps the modal open with the backend's Spanish message. Deleting the shared movement from the pocket reverses the whole abono (children cascade, parents revert by derivation); deleting or resizing one shared child is refused. On /panel/accounting/pocket, a movement carrying more than one allocation swaps its 'Vinculado' badge for an 'Abono · N ingresos' button opening a read-only modal with the per-income reparto and its total. From the income side, the detail modal names the pocket movement behind each settlement: a shared abono reads "Abono" in Tipo and offers "Abono · N ingresos", which opens the same read-only reparto — siblings included — stacked over the detail (which stops answering Esc and the backdrop while it is up); a 1:1 movement is named as text and a settlement that never touched the pocket renders an em dash. Served by GET accounting/incomes/<id>/detail/, whose liquid rows now carry a nested `movement`. Requisito de cobro (2026-10-06): las filas con cliente sólo participan cuando tienen cuenta emitida; las excluidas se explican antes del reparto. Una anulación concurrente causa rechazo atómico del servidor. Formulario compacto (2026-10-09): el modal usa el ancho de formulario (42 rem); valor recibido y fecha comparten fila y el destino se lee debajo de ella.
